[arctar-summon]
You close your eyes and reach out with your mind towards the Demon Plane, seeking out the presence
of Arctar, the Defender. Your search is successful and a burden descends upon
your soul as the possession takes hold.
[arctar-banish]
You close your eyes and focus all your willpower on the demon that is possessing you, driving away
the presence of Arctar, the Defender.
[arctar-shield]
You focus upon your pact and a terrifying visage of Arctar, the Defender appears briefly in front of
yourself, wreathed in flames.
A thin protective layer envelops you softly.
[arctar-ready]
You are again able to unleash Arctar.
[unleash-ready]
You are again able to unleash a demon.
[warmth]
You start focusing on warming up your body.
[astralvision]
Gritting your teeth, you focus your will and expand your aura throughout the surroundings about you, seeking out the aura of others.
[distortion-up]
Clenching your fists, you focus your will on distorting the air around yourself, and a vibrant violet glow surrounds you.
[distortion-down]
You concentrate on returning the distorted air around you back to normal, and the vibrant violet glow slowly fades.
[mindseye-up]
Touching the mindseye tattoo, your senses are suddenly heightened.
[mindseye-down]
You relax your mindseye.
[tattoo-shield]
You touch the tattoo and a shimmering translucent shield forms around you.
[shield-down]
Your action causes the shimmering translucent shield around you to fade away.
